note: Since 2.2 an argument of a call F-Call resolves may read a same-file call's result anywhere inside it: a member read in an object literal (second.left) or a bare reference in an array (first). The call is bound by a top-level const with a callee F-Call admits, and it is resolved once per file, so first is invoked once for both reads (F-Count): five invocations in all, first, second, member, listed, and describe in plain.ts. A result that is not an entity or a composite instance is left to F-Eval-Ident, which re-folds the call and rejects, so plain.ts, whose describe returns plain data, runs.
